verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents an official MCP server that lets LLMs work directly with its API and docs. Named clients such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Claude Desktop can use it to operate on an Appwrite project, and a hosted version is reachable from the Claude Code/Codex plugins after one OAuth sign-in. A probe confirmed the MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration that the MCP server works as documented.
